cells.title: Your code stays on your machine
cells.text: Embeddings and answers come from Ollama running locally; nothing is fine-tuned or uploaded.

cells.title: Retrieve, then answer
cells.text: Answers are built from the indexed chunks of your folder.

cells.title: Many languages
cells.text: C#, Java, TS/JS, Python, configs and docs in one index.

cells.title: Chat anywhere
cells.text: Interactive menu, CLI, a Gradio browser UI or any OpenAI-compatible client.

cells.title: Share an index
cells.text: Export and import an index as a pack.
